caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design with prominent use of green and red colors on a beige background. In the upper left quadrant, there is a cluster of four broad, lobed green leaves, each with white vein markings, arranged radially around a central, red, star-shaped figure. Extending from the bottom right corner towards the center are two green, scalloped, semi-circular lines forming a repeated border. Along these scalloped lines, groups of three red comb-like objects hang, each group tied with a small red bow at the attachment point. The entire composition is enclosed within a thin green border, and the background is filled with fine diagonal beige lines. There is a small strip of discoloration or tape near the lower right edge inside the border.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
